summary.business_type: B2B SaaS — Education / Campus ERP & LMS (with local-business HQ in Coimbatore, India)
top_findings: Near-zero off-site authority: only 2 referring hosts in Common Crawl; domain PageRank rank ~52 millionth — the single biggest growth blocker.
98% of clicks are branded ('aveon', 'aveon infotech', 'aveon erp'); non-branded impressions convert ZERO clicks.
Non-branded category terms (college erp software, campus management system) sit on page 2+ or barely register.
Technical SEO, schema and Core Web Vitals (field) are genuinely excellent — the site is well-built but commercially invisible for non-brand demand.
Several thin pages (/partners 124w, /academy 232w, /solutions/by-state 225w) and Organization-only blog authorship weaken E-E-A-T.
quick_wins: Add a named Person author (with bio + credentials) to blog Article schema for E-E-A-T.
Add Content-Security-Policy header (all other security headers already present).
Enrich the thin pages (/partners, /academy, /solutions/by-state) above ~500 words.
Publish llms.txt and consider Content-Signal lines (optional AI-search hygiene).
Add FAQ + SoftwareApplication/breadcrumb schema to solutions and NAAC/NBA sub-pages that currently lack them.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt clean: Allow /, blocks only /api/ and /studio/, declares deliberate groups for all major AI crawlers.
Valid sitemap.xml with 59 URLs, submitted to GSC, 0 warnings / 0 errors.
Legacy .php URLs 308-redirect to new Next.js routes (e.g. /college-erp.php -> /products/college-erp).
Security headers present: HSTS (2yr), X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
Server-rendered HTML (2,000+ words without JS); canonicals self-referential and matching Google's chosen canonical.
Key pages 'Submitted and indexed' in GSC with breadcrumb rich results passing.

findings.title: Legacy .php URLs still out-ranking their new targets
findings.description: /college-erp.php pulls 1,479 impressions at pos 4.7 while its 308 target /products/college-erp gets 427 impressions at pos 6.9. Redirects are correct; Google simply hasn't finished consolidating equity to the new URLs.
findings.recommendation: Keep the 308s, resubmit new URLs via the Indexing API, and ensure every internal link points to the new path. Monitor until legacy URLs drop from the index.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy (report-only added 2026-11-06)
findings.description: A Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only header was added in next.config.ts (non-breaking; keeps static rendering). Not yet enforcing.
findings.recommendation: Configure a report-to endpoint, review violations, then rename the header to Content-Security-Policy to enforce.

findings.title: App subdomains appear in search (messtoken.aveoninfotech.com)
findings.description: Client/app subdomains surface in GSC results for client-portal login queries; harmless but dilutes brand SERP.
findings.recommendation: Confirm app subdomains are noindex where appropriate and not competing with marketing pages.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Money pages are substantial: /products/college-erp ~2,593 words, /products/university-erp ~1,973 words, /comparisons ~1,500 words.
12 topical blog guides (NAAC, NBA, AICTE, NIRF, OBE, ERP migration) targeting real buyer questions.
FAQ content present and marked up on product, contact and accreditation pages.

findings.title: Blog authorship is Organization, not a credentialed Person
findings.description: Article schema uses author @type Organization. For E-E-A-T in a YMYL-adjacent B2B niche, named experts with bios and credentials are far stronger.
findings.recommendation: Add Person author entities with bio, role and sameAs (LinkedIn) to each guide; show author boxes on-page.

findings.title: Thin pages (partially fixed 2026-11-06)
findings.description: /partners was genuinely thin (~124 words) and was expanded with per-model detail, why-partner, a process section and an FAQ (plus FAQ/breadcrumb schema). Correction: automated counts for /academy, /solutions/by-state and /solutions/coimbatore were understated by the renderer; on source review /academy and /solutions/by-state are substantial, not thin.
findings.recommendation: Partners done. Optionally add named local institutions to /solutions/coimbatore later.

findings.title: Blog content batch-published same date
findings.description: Multiple guides share datePublished = dateModified = 2026-11-03, a scaled-content pattern.
findings.recommendation: Stagger updates, add original data/screenshots/case detail so pages read as genuinely maintained.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, keyword-aligned titles and meta descriptions per page; homepage title 'Campus ERP & LMS for Universities & Colleges | Aveon Infotech'.
Clear heading hierarchy and descriptive internal linking between related products.
og:/twitter: tags and theme-color present; canonical correct.

findings.title: Legacy meta keywords tag in use
findings.description: A long meta keywords tag is present (deprecated, ignored by Google; harmless but signals dated SEO).
findings.recommendation: Remove meta keywords; redirect effort to body copy and internal anchors.

findings.title: Non-branded intent under-served by internal anchors
findings.description: Category head terms (college erp software, campus management system) rank page 2+. Internal anchor text and hub structure under-reinforce these.
findings.recommendation: Build a topic-cluster internal-link model: product pages as money pages, blog guides linking up with exact-match/partial anchors.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Sitewide Organization + LocalBusiness + WebSite JSON-LD, valid and consistent.
Product pages carry SoftwareApplication + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList.
Blog carries Article + WebPage + BreadcrumbList with dates.
GSC rich-results verdict PASS (breadcrumbs detected).

findings.title: Schema uneven across page types
findings.description: /solutions/* pages lack FAQ/SoftwareApplication; /products/iqac-naac-nba/naac has FAQ but no BreadcrumbList.
findings.recommendation: Standardise: Breadcrumb on every deep page, FAQ where Q&A exists, SoftwareApplication on every product/solution page.

findings.title: No aggregateRating / review schema despite real GBP reviews
findings.description: Business has 4.2 stars / 54 Google reviews but no Review/AggregateRating markup is exposed.
findings.recommendation: Add AggregateRating (sourced legitimately) to Organization/SoftwareApplication to earn review rich results.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Field (CrUX) origin passes: LCP p75 2,181 ms (fast), CLS 0.03 (fast), TTFB 750 ms (fast).
Lighthouse mobile: Performance 85, Accessibility 96, Best-Practices 100, SEO 100.
Total page weight a reasonable 942 KiB; CLS essentially zero.

findings.title: INP borderline (origin p75 266 ms)
findings.description: Interaction to Next Paint is 'needs improvement' (good < 200 ms). Likely hydration/unused JS.
findings.recommendation: Reduce unused JavaScript (~450 ms flagged), defer non-critical scripts, trim third-party JS.

findings.title: Lab LCP 4.3s vs field 2.18s
findings.description: Lab is stricter than real-user data; LCP image preload is already in place.
findings.recommendation: Monitor; keep LCP image prioritised. No urgent action since field passes.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt explicitly welcomes GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, etc.
Server-rendered content readable by non-JS fetchers; rich entity schema aids extraction.
FAQ/Q&A structure supports passage-level citation.

findings.title: No off-site brand authority for AI engines to cite
findings.description: AI answer engines favour entities with third-party corroboration. With ~2 referring hosts and branded-only presence, the brand lacks the external footprint needed for non-branded AI citations.
findings.recommendation: Earn directory listings, review-site profiles (G2/Capterra/SoftwareSuggest), guest articles and press — the same lever that fixes organic authority.

findings.title: No llms.txt / Content-Signal / Markdown delivery
findings.description: Optional AI-discovery hygiene not implemented (none are ranking factors today).
findings.recommendation: Publish /llms.txt summarising key pages; optionally add Content-Signal lines to robots groups.

categories.name: Off-Site Authority & Backlinks
what_works: Domain is present in Common Crawl and in the ranking graph (not sandboxed/penalised).

findings.title: Near-zero backlink profile
findings.description: Only 2 referring hosts in the Common Crawl web graph; domain PageRank rank ~51,994,670 (harmonic-centrality rank ~10.9M). This is the primary reason non-branded commercial terms do not rank and traffic is 98% branded.
findings.recommendation: Launch a sustained link/citation program: software review sites (G2, Capterra, SoftwareSuggest, TrustRadius), Indian edtech directories, client case-study backlinks, HARO/press, and partner co-marketing. Target 20-30 quality referring domains over 2-3 months.

findings.title: No measurable authority flow to new URLs
findings.description: Equity from legacy .php pages and any historical links isn't translating into non-branded rankings.
findings.recommendation: Pair link-building with the internal topic-cluster model so new authority concentrates on money pages.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: LocalBusiness schema sitewide with exact NAP (Coimbatore, 641004), hours, geo and map link.
Google Business Profile exists (4.2 stars, 54 reviews); dedicated /solutions/coimbatore and state pages.
NAP in schema mirrors the GBP record.

findings.title: Review equity not surfaced on-site
findings.description: 54 real Google reviews aren't reflected in on-page content or schema.
findings.recommendation: Add a reviews/testimonials section and legitimate AggregateRating; link to the GBP.

findings.title: Local landing pages thin / templated
findings.description: /solutions/coimbatore (351w) and state pages risk being templated. Local citations beyond GBP are limited.
findings.recommendation: Add locally specific proof (named institutions, local case studies) and build India edtech citations.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% alt-text coverage on sampled pages (0 of 81 homepage images missing alt).
Next.js image pipeline serves WebP with responsive srcset and fetchpriority on LCP image.

findings.title: Alt text keyword quality not audited at scale
findings.description: Coverage is complete; descriptive quality should be spot-checked.
findings.recommendation: Ensure alt text is descriptive (not keyword-stuffed) and OG images are page-specific.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical — Build Off-Site Authority
items: Claim/complete G2, Capterra, SoftwareSuggest, TrustRadius profiles (do-follow + citation value).
List in Indian edtech / SaaS directories and local Coimbatore business directories (consistent NAP).
Turn existing clients into case-study backlinks (link from their sites / press).
Pitch 3-5 guest articles / expert quotes (HARO-style) in Indian education & edtech media.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact On-Page & E-E-A-T
items: Add named Person authors with bios + sameAs to all blog Article schema and on-page author boxes.
Add legitimate AggregateRating/Review schema reflecting the 54 Google reviews; add a testimonials section.
Build the topic-cluster internal-link model concentrating anchors on non-branded money terms.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Schema Depth
items: Standardise schema: Breadcrumb on every deep page, FAQ + SoftwareApplication on solutions & accreditation sub-pages.
Publish comparison/alternatives pages targeting competitor terms (e.g. 'X alternative', 'best college ERP software India').
Add original data/screenshots/client proof to the batch-published guides so they read as maintained.

phases.name: Phase 4: Performance & Monitoring
items: Reduce unused JS to pull INP under 200 ms (field).
Monitor legacy .php -> new URL consolidation in GSC; resubmit via Indexing API.
Track non-branded clicks/impressions and referring-domain count monthly as the north-star KPIs.
